annotation.interpretation_a: N may be any integer, including negative, so codes below 0x21 would also be prohibited by the formula.
annotation.interpretation_b: N is intended to be a non‑negative integer, so only codes from 0x21 upward are prohibited by the formula.
annotation.justification: The clause specifies a formula 0x1f * N + 0x21 for integer values of N but does not constrain N to be non‑negative. This omission allows two materially different interpretations: one allowing negative N (prohibiting codes below 0x21) and one restricting N to non‑negative values (prohibiting only codes from 0x21 upward).
